text.lead: Midgets vs. Mascots is a 2009 direct to video mockumentary film. It is notable for being the last film appearance of former Diff’rent Strokes child star Gary Coleman before his death in May 2010.
text.plot: Ten contestants consisting of five little people and five mascots compete in a series of competitions for ten million dollars in prize money.
